''See also: [[Sword Icon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Sword]] [[Icon]] is a powerful conceptual symbol representing the essence of swordsmanship. To manifest an [[Icon]], an individual must become a living embodiment of a specific concept through deep spiritual [[resonance]]. While many practitioners, such as [[Archlord|Archlords]], spend lifetimes attempting to achieve this state, certain individuals like [[Yerin|Yerin Arelius]] have begun to reflect it. Although [[Underlord|Underlords]] typically lack the clarity of [[Way|the Way]] required to manifest an [[Icon]], [[Yerin]]'s ability to do so serves as a sign of her potential as a [[sacred artist]]. Historically, three [[Sages]] of the same generation achieved this manifestation: the [[Sage of Fallen Blades]], the [[Sage of the Endless Sword]] (also known as [[Timaias Adama|Adama]]), and a third individual. [[Heralds]] are also capable of resonating with [[The Sword|the Sword]] [[Icon]], though they may experience it only as a quiet whisper. While the icon is most commonly associated with swords as the ideal tools for cutting and combat, its [[Authority|authority]] can potentially be channeled through various types of cutting weapons.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[The Sword]] [[Icon]] is a specific type of [[Icon]] and a manifestation held by certain [[Sages]] that represents a powerful concept. As an entity that practitioners can develop a connection to, it may manifest before one reaches the rank of [[Archlord]], though [[Archlord|Archlords]] often spend lifetimes pursuing it. During her journey, [[Yerin]] seeks to grow closer to the [[Icon]] and works on her connection to it, even finding that she can feel its presence when pushing herself or when the influence of her [[Shadow]] is weakened. The [[Icon]] has guided [[Yerin]] in battle by providing advice, such as instructing her to run power through her [[sword]] to pull it free. While spirits are unable to touch [[Icons]], living humans can interact with them, and the feeling of the [[Icon]] eventually settled around [[Yerin]] before she could no longer sense it.}}
